title: Creating a Technical Installation
text:
Creating a Technical Installation
Creating a Technical Installation
Use
You can create a technical installation when you create a new premise or change an already existing premise.
Procedure
Choose
Utilities industry
Technical master data
Premise
Create
or
Change
.
If you are in change mode, enter a premise.
Choose
Premise
Techn. inst.
(technical installation
)
Create
.
Enter the division and, if necessary, a description.
A temporary equipment number is displayed in the
Equipment
field.
Save the premise.
The technical installation is created in
Plant Maintenance and Service Management
(PM). as a piece of equipment with its own number.
To maintain the technical installation as a piece of equipment, proceed as follows:
Display the technical installation.
Double click the equipment to call it.
The
Display Equipment: General Data
screen appears.
Choose
Equipment
Create.
Result
You have created a technical installation and allocated it to a premise.
